subject: general
question: As per Census 2011, which of the following states of India has the highest sex ratio?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kerala.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In **India, Kerala **State has the** highest sex ratio.**
 
• According to the **2011 censu**s, it has a **sex ratio of 1084.**
 
• **Puducherry, Tamil Nadu, and Andhra Pradesh** are next in line.
 
• The ratio of** males to females** in a population is the** "sex ratio".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• According to the most recent census,** Madhya Pradesh's gender ratio** is **931, **or for every 1000 men, which is lower than the national average of **940.**
 
• The sex ratio in **Uttar Pradesh is 912**, or for every 1000 men, which is lower than the **national average of 940.**
 
• Maharashtra's** sex ratio is 929**, or for every **1000 men, which is lower than the national average of 940.**
